rules.when: Applicable current official Games Workshop evidence conflicts with any non-official source.
rules.resolution: Official evidence controls normative rule truth; preserve secondary disagreement as drift evidence.

rules.when: Wahapedia and BSData disagree on a rules/points/constraint fact.
rules.resolution: SOURCE_CONFLICT; verify official source before promotion.

rules.when: BSData catalogue state and New Recruit runtime/wiki projection disagree.
Wahapedia, BSData and New Recruit agree but applicable official evidence has not been checked.
rules.resolution: May record HIGH_CONFIDENCE_SECONDARY evidence, but normative fact remains CURRENT_PENDING_RECHECK.

rules.when: Goonhammer, Stat Check, BCP or community discussion conflicts with normative rule data.
rules.resolution: Keep analysis/empirical claim separate. Never modify normative rules from analytics.

rules.when: WTC or another event pack/ruling differs from global matched-play rules.
rules.resolution: EVENT_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE; apply only when that event ruleset is explicitly selected.
